verify.subject: Verify your hackOS email
verify.body:
Hi {{name}},

Confirm your email address to unlock the rest of hackOS:

[Verify email]({{verifyUrl}})

Did we land in spam? Move this message to your inbox and add {{fromAddress}} to your contacts so you don't miss future messages.

If you didn't request this, ignore this message.

verifySecondaryEmail.subject: Confirm your secondary email for hackOS
verifySecondaryEmail.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your hackOS account ({{primaryEmail}}) asked to add {{secondaryEmail}} as a secondary address, so we can match your Devpost projects to your account:

[Confirm {{secondaryEmail}}]({{verifyUrl}})

Did we land in spam? Move this message to your inbox and add {{fromAddress}} to your contacts so you don't miss future messages.

If you didn't request this, ignore this message — your account won't change.

reset.subject: Reset your hackOS password
reset.body:
Hi {{name}},

Use this button to set a new password:

[Reset password]({{resetUrl}})

Did we land in spam? Move this message to your inbox and add {{fromAddress}} to your contacts so you don't miss future messages.

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email — your password hasn't changed.

accountRemovalPin.subject: Confirm your hackOS account removal
accountRemovalPin.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your security PIN for removing your hackOS account is:

{{pin}}

This PIN expires in {{expiresMinutes}} minutes. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

invite.subject: You're invited to hackOS
invite.body:
Hi,

Create your account to continue:

[Create account]({{claimUrl}})

Did we land in spam? Move this message to your inbox and add {{fromAddress}} to your contacts so you don't miss future messages.

Set your password, name and the rest of your details from there.

invite.subject: You've been invited to join {{projectName}}
invite.body:
Hi,

{{inviterName}} invited you to join their project {{projectName}} on hackOS.

Open My Project to accept or decline the invite.

called.subject: Your team was called
called.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} was called for {{challengeName}}. Please head to room {{roomName}} and wait at the door until you are called in.

precall.subject: You're up soon
precall.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your team {{teamName}} is about {{etaMinutes}} minutes from being called for {{challengeName}}. Start getting ready.

enter.subject: Come on in
enter.body:
Hi {{name}},

It's your team's turn for {{challengeName}}. Please come in now to room {{roomName}}.

message.subject: Message about {{challengeName}}

enter.subject: Team entering {{roomName}}
enter.body: {{teamName}} was asked to enter room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

called.subject: Team called for {{roomName}}
called.body: {{teamName}} was called to wait at the door of room {{roomName}} for {{challengeName}}.

decision.subject: A decision on your application
decision.body:
Hi {{name}},

Your application to {{applicationName}} has been {{decision}}.{{decisionDetails}}

reminder.subject: Reminder: {{title}}

precall.title: You're up soon — get ready
precall.body: Your team {{teamName}} will be called for {{challengeName}} in about {{etaMinutes}} minutes.

called.title: Go wait at room {{roomName}}
called.body: Wait at the door for {{challengeName}}. We'll tell you when to enter.
